newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil 1997 coffee demand seen near 12 mln bags.
newsitem.headline: Brazil 1997 coffee demand seen near 12 mln bags.

text.p: Brazilian domestic coffee consumption in 1997 should reach 11.73 million 60-kg bags, very close to a previous forecast by the Brazilian Coffee Industry Association (Abic) of 12 million bags, Abic said in a statement.
Consumption in the twelve months to end-May 1997 showed an increase of 6.81 percent over the corresponding period in 1995/96, Abic said.
"Our forecast was for a growth of nine percent," said Abic secretary-general David Nahum.
"But we have to consider there were price increases in roasted and ground coffee in the first half of 1997 because of the rise in international green coffee prices," he added.
For the second half of the year, Abic is expecting an increase at least equal to if not slightly higher than the 6.81 percent.
"The important thing is that we are continuing to join forces to reach the goal of 15 million bags in the year 2000," Nahum said.
